title: A diff whose two sides read the same is a character you cannot see: dump code points before changing the code

commands.reason: vitest's FAIL header names tests/ambient.test.mjs; the whitespace class the formula normalizes covers both spaces, so the key is the same whichever side of the mismatch appears
an assertion diff carries no errno and vitest's frame line ends the block, so the message lane derives nothing
the package script forwards the file to the same runner and prints the same header
